# usefulapi

Hosted [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) servers for the tools you already use — connect
from Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client. No local install, no key-juggling: authorize once and go.

**Portal:** https://usefulapi.io

and a tile on the [portal](https://usefulapi.io)._

## What's in each folder

- `README.md` — what the server does, tools, pricing, the "Add to Claude" snippet
- `server.json` — the [official MCP Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io) record
  (namespace `io.usefulapi/*`), pointing at the hosted endpoint

toolsPreview.name: zendesk_search
toolsPreview.description: Unified search across tickets, users, organizations and groups using Zendesk search syntax. Examples: `type:ticket status:open`, `type:user email:jane@acme.com`, `type:organization name:acme`. Zendesk REST: GET /search.json.

toolsPreview.name: zendesk_list_tickets
toolsPreview.description: List recent tickets (offset pagination). Zendesk REST: GET /tickets.json.

toolsPreview.name: zendesk_get_ticket
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a single ticket by id. Zendesk REST: GET /tickets/{id}.json.

toolsPreview.name: zendesk_list_ticket_comments
toolsPreview.description: List the comments (public replies and internal notes) on a ticket, oldest first. Zendesk REST: GET /tickets/{id}/comments.json.

toolsPreview.name: zendesk_current_user
toolsPreview.description: Return the currently authenticated user — a quick way to verify credentials and subdomain. Zendesk REST: GET /users/me.json.

toolsPreview.name: zendesk_get_user
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a single user by id. Zendesk REST: GET /users/{id}.json.

toolsPreview.name: zendesk_search_users
toolsPreview.description: Find users by name, email, phone, or other attributes. Zendesk REST: GET /users/search.json.

toolsPreview.name: zendesk_list_organizations
toolsPreview.description: List organizations (offset pagination). Zendesk REST: GET /organizations.json.

toolsPreview.name: zendesk_get_organization
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a single organization by id. Zendesk REST: GET /organizations/{id}.json.

toolsPreview.name: zendesk_list_groups
toolsPreview.description: List agent groups. Zendesk REST: GET /groups.json.

toolsPreview.name: zendesk_list_views
toolsPreview.description: List saved ticket views (curated ticket lists). Use zendesk_execute_view to run one. Zendesk REST: GET /views.json.

toolsPreview.name: zendesk_execute_view
toolsPreview.description: Run a saved view by id and return the matching tickets. Zendesk REST: GET /views/{id}/execute.json.

toolsPreview.name: zendesk_list_macros
toolsPreview.description: List macros (reusable sets of ticket actions/replies agents apply). Zendesk REST: GET /macros.json.

toolsPreview.name: zendesk_list_ticket_fields
toolsPreview.description: List all standard and custom ticket fields — useful for discovering field ids/values before creating or updating tickets. Zendesk REST: GET /ticket_fields.json.

toolsPreview.name: zendesk_get_ticket_metrics
toolsPreview.description: Fetch SLA / response / resolution time metrics for a ticket. Zendesk REST: GET /tickets/{id}/metrics.json.

toolsPreview.name: zendesk_list_satisfaction_ratings
toolsPreview.description: List customer satisfaction (CSAT) ratings, optionally filtered by score. Zendesk REST: GET /satisfaction_ratings.json.

toolsPreview.name: zendesk_create_ticket
toolsPreview.description: MUTATING: create a new support ticket. `subject` and `comment_body` are required; the comment becomes the ticket's first message. Zendesk REST: POST /tickets.json.

toolsPreview.name: zendesk_update_ticket
toolsPreview.description: MUTATING: update an existing ticket. Provide the ticket `id` plus at least one field to change (status, priority, assignee_id, group_id, type, tags, or a comment). Zendesk REST: PUT /tickets/{id}.json.

toolsPreview.name: zendesk_add_ticket_comment
toolsPreview.description: MUTATING: add a comment to a ticket. `public` defaults to true (a reply visible to the requester); set it false for an internal agent note. Convenience over PUT /tickets/{id}.json.
